text_content: Gia dinh toi da on dinh, khong can ho tro them.

name: Tran Thi Bich
text_content: Muc nuoc dang tang, can theo doi them.

name: Pham Thu Ha
text_content: Gia dinh toi da di chuyen len cao hon.

name: Dang Ngoc Anh
text_content: Khu nay ngap nang, can cuu ho gap, co nguoi mac ket.

name: Le Hoang Nam
text_content: Nha dang bi ngap mot phan, can ho tro di chuyen.
